jobs.title: Legal Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. THE ROLE We are looking for a skilled, tech-savvy Legal Operations Specialist to join our fast-paced legal team. As a core member of the department within a leading payment processing company, you will help drive operational excellence, scale our legal tech stack, and streamline workflows. The ideal candidate helps bridge the gap between legal expertise, technology, and data-driven efficiency. You will be responsible for managing our complex contract ecosystems, optimising team collaboration tools, and leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) to design modern, automated legal processes. Key Responsibilities: Legal Tech Stack & Automation Strategy: Support the administration, integration, and continuous improvement of our legal technology tools, with a heavy emphasis on Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems. Atlassian Ecosystem: Support the legal department's Jira infrastructure. This includes assisting with the design, maintenance, and optimisation of workflows in Jira Service Management (JSM) for legal intake, helping manage Jira Space

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel UK/EU
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel with substantial experience in consumer-facing technology businesses to join our global Legal & Corporate Affairs team at an exciting period in Trustly's growth. You will be responsible for partnering with our commercial teams to draft, negotiate, and close a wide variety of transactions across the EU and UK. This role will work cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, consumer partnerships, compliance, and operations teams at Trustly to support the sustainable growth of a hyper-scale business across the EU and UK. You will manage multiple simultaneous complex negotiations, requiring the ability to prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines. You will be a highly commercial and pragmatic individual who thrives on closing deals and enjoys partnering closely with business teams, to speak with "one voice" to external counterparties whilst launching and scaling products and services. You will possess strong experience working from counterparty's terms and templates, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to efficiently negotiate and close deals whilst protecting Trustly's interests. You will be comfortable pushing back strongly on firm redlines

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description: About Notabene Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry! The Role We're seeking a commercially minded Commercial Counsel based in Europe to work closely with and support our General Counsel, who is based in the New York City area. You'll help manage sophisticated international commercial transactions with leading global banks, financial institutions, and other multinational companies, advise internal business teams, and support the development of our legal operations and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on role requiring strong commercial judgment, technical understanding, and the ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions worldwide. Where You’ll Work This is a 100% remote role open to candidates based in Europe. Support the General Counsel in managing international commercial negotiations, while independently handling assigned contracts and projects. Implement AI-powered legal tools, improve contracting workflows, and drive legal operations and process improvements. jobs.title: Partner Risk Delivery Lead
jobs.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍UK Remote (with essential travel to our global offshore sites) | 💰£41,300 - £52,250 + Incentive Awards + Benefits ✨ Our Global Ops Team ⭐️ Monzo relies on partners across a growing global estate to deliver safe, resilient and consistent outcomes for customers. The Partner Risk Delivery Lead exists to turn our partner risk standards into consistent day to day practice, ensuring controls are understood, evidence is reliable and issues are followed through to closure. You will work directly with partner account teams and risk leads, as well as colleagues across Global Ops, Operations, TPRM and specialist teams. You will independently own defined areas of partner risk delivery, investigate concerns and help partners embed Monzo’s expectations across every location and country we serve. As Partner Risk Delivery Lead , you will independently operate the Partner Risk Management framework set by the Partner Risk Manager. You will own agreed delivery areas from planning through to completion, maintain accurate records and evidence, challenge where standards are not met and escalate material concerns. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
